gotchas: Use the /en-us/ storefront (e.g. /en-us/search?q=…). Many sock listings showed every colour 'Out of Stock' on 2026-10-06; a t-shirt worked. Size is a radio group (press Space on input[type=radio][name*=size]); the add button is button[data-pdp-add-to-bag="true"] (two match; use the visible one).
An Attentive 'Sign Up via Text' overlay (iframe#attentive_creative) covers the page and takes clicks; close it by pressing Enter on #closeIconContainer in that frame. A cookie banner also shows.

Checkout starts as a guest directly: Shipping -> Payment -> Contact Information, each with its own continue button. 'Continue to Payment' (#btn-shipping-submit) first opens a 'Member Checkout' dialog; choose 'Continue As Guest'.

State is a custom combobox (combobox 'State' next to a hidden textbox): open it and click the two-letter option (e.g. 'CA'). The address typeahead (api.edq.com) offers suites; an address without a suite at a multi-unit building gets a 'Please Verify Your Address' dialog — 'Review Address', then pick a suggestion.

Payment: 'Credit Card' is pre-selected. Card number, expiry, security code and name on card are ALL in one iframe (iframe[id*="card"]), addressed by aria-label. Billing 'Same as shipping address' is pre-checked. Then 'Continue to Contact' (email/phone come after the card on this site).
Card fields probed read-only on 2026-10-06 and not filled, so card selectors are unverified. Order summary shows 'Total:'; no order.total hint was settled.
Through the proxy from a US tunnel on 2026-10-06 no bot wall or challenge appeared.
